title: V-JEPA 2
description: Self-supervised video models for understanding, prediction, and planning.
coverAlt: Observed video frames feed an encoder, whose features guide a predicted future and a goal.

title: CALM
description: A continuous VAE frame and a consistency-model sampler replace stacked RVQ tokens in audio language models.
coverAlt: A waveform is encoded by a VAE into one continuous vector per frame, replacing stacked RVQ levels; a language model and consistency head then sample the next vector.

title: Small-Scale Experiments
description: Scaling laws for language models only appear once hyperparameters are tuned to the fully optimized frontier at each scale.
coverAlt: A log-log plot of loss against model scale: a wide scatter of tuning runs at small scale narrows toward a fitted scaling-law curve as scale grows, marking the best attainable loss.

title: λ-JEPA
description: A spectral anti-collapse regularizer on the backbone features, not just the projection, keeps JEPA-style representations from staying low rank.
coverAlt: A backbone representation collapsed onto a line is projected by a nonlinear head into a cloud that looks full rank; a log-determinant regularizer on the backbone pulls it open.

title: DINOv3
description: DINOv3 rebuilt step by step: DINO self-distillation, iBOT masked patches, KoLeo, registers and Gram anchoring, and why each one is needed.
coverAlt: A staircase from DINO to DINOv3 where each step keeps the previous techniques and adds one: self-distillation, masked patch prediction, KoLeo, registers, Gram anchoring.
